items.title: November 2026 Funding Opportunities
items.one_liner: A new list of 13 cross-cutting and intersectional funding opportunities was published.
items.why: Useful for identifying potential grants supporting research on urban ecosystems and sustainability.
items.action: Check the listed opportunities for relevant academic research grants.

items.title: Nepal to Push for Mountain Agenda at COP31
items.one_liner: Nepal announced plans to push for a permanent mountain agenda and faster disaster funding at COP31.
items.why: Highly relevant to mountainous, data-scarce settings and high-altitude urban environmental challenges.
items.action: Monitor COP31 updates regarding specific policy mechanisms proposed for mountain regions.

items.title: Ho Chi Minh City 100-Year Master Plan Approved
items.one_liner: Ho Chi Minh City's 100-year master plan received official approval.
items.why: Provides a large-scale master planning example for rapidly developing mega-urban areas in the Global South.
items.action: Examine the plan to see how land-cover change and ecosystem services are integrated.

items.title: Hung Yen to Develop Eco-Tourism Urban Area
items.one_liner: Hung Yen is set to develop an 831-hectare eco-tourism urban area.
items.why: Illustrates large-scale peri-urban transformation and green-blue infrastructure development in Asia.
items.action: Investigate how the project balances tourist development with local ecological functions.

items.title: Financing Resilience for Dhaka’s Food Vendors
items.one_liner: IFPRI discussed financing resilience for food vendors in Dhaka under future urban heat.
items.why: Directly relates to urban cooling, heat mitigation, and social vulnerability in South Asian cities.
items.action: Read the brief to connect climate vulnerability frameworks with urban food systems.

items.title: Climate-Vulnerable Bangladesh Areas Struggle for Bank Credit
items.one_liner: Bangladesh's climate-vulnerable regions are facing difficulties in accessing bank credit.
items.why: Exposes financial barriers affecting climate adaptation and resilience in vulnerable economies.
items.action: Consider how economic constraints impede local investments in ecosystem-based adaptation.

items.title: Centering Equity in Ecosystem-based Adaptation
items.one_liner: IUCN published guidelines on centering equity in Ecosystem-based Adaptation to link biodiversity to people.
items.why: Connects directly with plural values, environmental justice, and human benefits of ecosystem services.
items.source: International Union for Conservation of Nature
items.action: Incorporate IUCN's equity principles into frameworks for evaluating ecosystem service access.

items.title: Sub-Saharan Africa's Urban Awakening
items.one_liner: The World Bank published a report on Sub-Saharan Africa's urban growth and development.
items.why: Offers comparative insights on urbanization patterns and planning challenges in Global South cities.
items.action: Review the publication for trends on urban development and settlement morphology.

items.title: Citizens Push Back Against Projects Threatening Green Cover
items.one_liner: Citizens in India are pushing back against infrastructure projects that reduce green cover.
items.why: Highlights public pushback, environmental justice, and access to urban nature in developing settings.
items.action: Note how community resistance shapes urban planning outcomes and green space protection.

items.title: Top Global Cities Growing More Urban Forests
items.one_liner: Corporate Knights reported on global cities expanding their urban forests.
items.why: Informs strategies for urban cooling, canopy cover expansion, and nature-based solutions.
items.action: Compare the highlighted municipal tree-planting methods with data-scarce context approaches.

items.title: Taiwan Shares Climate Resilience Experience at ARISE Forum
items.one_liner: Taiwan shared climate resilience and disaster management experience at the ARISE Cities Forum 2026.
items.why: Provides methods and insights on disaster management in mountainous, hazard-prone regions.
items.action: Look for presentation summaries on spatial resilience and risk mitigation strategies.

note: Selected updates, not comprehensive coverage. Status is unverified unless supported by the quoted official excerpt.
